name: Karina Nadila
bio: Karina Nadila Niab, born on August 21, 1992, in Jakarta, Indonesia, is an accomplished actress, model, TV presenter, and beauty queen. Crowned as Puteri Indonesia Pariwisata 2017, she represented Indonesia at the Miss Supranational 2017 pageant. Born to a mother of Minangkabau-Dutch descent, Jumaini Weissheimer, and raised by her stepfather, Lukius Niab, from the traditional Timorese tribe, Karina decided to pursue a career in beauty pageantry, modeling, and makeup content creation at the age of seventeen. This decision led to collaborations with various beauty brands and opportunities in film acting and TV presenting.
